query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `admin_cards_arquivados` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
  `cardId` varchar(64) NOT NULL,
  `cardTitulo` varchar(128) NOT NULL,
  `motivo` text,
  `archivedBy` varchar(64),
  `archivedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
  CONSTRAINT `admin_cards_arquivados_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `admin_cards_arquivados_cardId_unique` UNIQUE(`cardId`)
);
